_what: The person's redaction of what the AI reads off this Mac's screen (computer/ask-payload.mjs redactor, used by computer/drive-the-screen.mjs). If the person turned `redact` on (their own file `prefs_file`; off until they choose), every screen read is redacted here on the Mac by `patterns` before it can leave: a pattern is a regular expression and what replaces a match.

words.bad_pattern: The pattern {id} is not a valid expression.
